title: Silver Zoom Card: Managing Multiple Vehicle Expenses
summary: This document explains how to use the Silver Zoom Card to manage fleet spending: issue up to 60 driver cards under one account, assign cards to specific vehicles/routes, set a per-driver daily cap at or below $1,250, and apply category controls so the cap covers primarily fuel and approved logistics. It also states that fueling outside the home country incurs a 2.5% foreign transaction fee and outlines a reconciliation workflow using vehicle/route tagging and exception review near or above $1,250.
faqs: How many driver cards can I issue under a single Silver Zoom Card account?
Can I limit spending by vehicle or route for easier reconciliation?
What per-driver daily spending cap can I set, and what’s the $1,250 threshold for?
How do category controls affect what expenses count toward the daily cap (e.g., fuel vs other costs)?
What foreign transaction fee applies to fueling outside my home country?
How should I reconcile purchases and review exceptions when spend is near or exceeds $1,250?
